overview: The April 2025 developer announcement envisages 81,200 homes, 800 hotel keys and 144,000 residents. These are masterplan ambitions, not delivered inventory.

A community purchase still needs a building name, unit number and approved plan. Access to a district-wide attraction should be checked separately from facilities contractually included with the selected tower.
research.locationNote: City of Arabia, Dubailand, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road(E 311) and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street(D 54), beside IMG Worlds of Adventure. The developer’s future Blue Line reference is proposed connectivity, not an operating station or confirmed walking route for every building.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains AED 560,000 as a Milan launch reference. Its page combines selected apartment/duplex releases rather than pricing the entire district. A current building-specific developer price list and live availability were not verified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder separately publishes 10% booking/50% construction/40% handover and 10%/60%/30% alternatives. Each totals 100%, but no retrieved document makes either a universal Milan-community plan. Confirm the named building, chosen unit, instalment dates, fees and any promotion in a dated offer.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder lists June 2028/Q2 2028 for its selected Milan offering. The developer’s master community release does not establish one handover date for all buildings. Tower schedules, district infrastructure and amenity openings require separate confirmation; no whole-community completion date is asserted.

unresolved: No master community-wide approved apartment size range, service-charge budget, parking entitlement, furnishing schedule or current inventory was established. Obtain the individual tower documents.
Planned school, healthcare, hospitality, retail and transport facilities have separate delivery and operating milestones. Do not assume they are ready with an apartment.
Carbon-neutrality and regional fashion-capital claims are developer aspirations, not independently established certification or permanent rankings. Images remain illustrative.
